integrity: All stated finite identities have analytic derivations and standalone exact-rational checks; asymptotic statements follow from uniform expansions, Gaussian localization, and controlled summation. Scientific historical priority has only self-review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer collector count q>=3, uniform independent coupons, distinct-count synchronization; no q growing with alphabet, elapsed-round hitting time, nonuniform coupon weights, or later winner probabilities. The two-player exact distribution is credited to prior work; the new contribution concerns q>=3 first-exit asymptotics and rare simultaneous laggards.
title: Second-order desynchronization and rare multiple laggards in multi-collector coupon races
